title: ALMA <SUP>13</SUP>CO(J = 1-0) observations of NGC 604 in M33: physical properties of molecular clouds
question: Whether the 13CO(J=1-0) emission from molecular clouds in NGC 604 obeys Larson's scaling relations, what the physical properties of the clouds are, and what the state of star formation is in the region.

data.angular_resolution: 3.2 x 2.4 arcsec (13 x 10 pc) for line; 3.9 x 2.8 arcsec for continuum; minimum beam 2.2 arcsec
data.sensitivity: 2.6 mJy beam^-1 (line rms); 0.04 mJy beam^-1 (continuum rms)

what.value: Nobeyama Millimeter Array 12CO(J=1-0) cloud identifications and properties in NGC 604 (NMA clouds)

evidence.quote: We compared our results with the results from (cite: Miura2010), who show observations of $^{12}$CO(J=1-0) line emission from NGC 604 as observed by the Nobeyama Millimeter Array.

what.value: 12CO emission GMC properties in NGC 604 for size-linewidth and virial-luminous mass comparisons

recipe.goal: Calibrate visibility data and image 13CO(1-0) line cube and 104 GHz continuum
recipe.method: Standard pipeline calibration followed by imaging with tclean using Briggs weighting
key_parameters: channel width = 0.664 km s^-1 for 13CO image

recipe.goal: Decompose 13CO(1-0) emission into hierarchical structures and identify molecular clouds
recipe.method: Dendrogram decomposition using ASTRODENDRO to identify trunks, branches, and leaves
key_parameters: local maxima threshold = 4 sigma_rms, delta above merge level = 3 sigma_rms

recipe.goal: Extract basic cloud properties and derive physical quantities (size, linewidth, masses, surface density, virial parameter)
recipe.method: Bijection approach in ASTRODENDRO for moments and fluxes; analytic equations for physical properties; bootstrap method with 50 iterations for uncertainties
assumptions: 13CO(1-0)-to-H2 conversion factor X_13CO = 1.0 x 10^21 cm^-2 / (K km s^-1) (X_2 = 5), including 1.36 helium factor
Truncated power-law density distribution rho propto R^-beta with beta = 1, and negligible magnetic fields and external pressure for virial mass

recipe.goal: Analyze Larson's scaling relations (size-linewidth and virial-luminous mass)
recipe.method: Compute Spearman rank correlation coefficients and compare against Milky Way, NGC 300, and previous NGC 604 relations

evidence.quote: We identified 20 structures in the entire dendrogram, consisting of 15 leaves and 4 branches, using the above parameters.

evidence.quote: We show in Figure 6 that the clouds in NGC 604 are in near virial equilibrium and that the data are strongly correlated, with a Spearman coefficient of $r_{s}=0.98$.

Using $^{13}$CO(J=1-0), we estimate a virial mass of $\mathrm{0.8\pm 0.3\times 10^5~M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}}$ and a molecular mass of $\mathrm{1.2\pm 0.2\times 10^5~M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}}$ in NMA-8, which is a factor of 5 less than the $^{12}$CO(J=1-0) molecular mass presented by (cite: Miura2010).
